page.overview:
Who is Menelaus?

Menelaus was a king of Sparta, and first husband of Helen of Troy. When Helen was taken Menelaus sent a call to all the original suitors to fight the Trojans who had taken Helen. Among the brave heroes that were on those ships were Agamemnon, Ajax the Greater, Akhilles, Thoas, Odysseus and Ajax the Lesser just to name a few.

Atreus (Father) Agamemnon (Brother) Helen (Wife)

Clytemnestra (Sister-in-law) Harmonie (Daughter)

Megapentes (son) Orestes (nephew) Electra (niece) Iphigenia (niece)
